units.title: SG-5.4 · Mocked-storage unit tests for frozen export and FrozenIDs
Act: Confirm Exporter.Export frozen-only, empty and error behavior
Act: Confirm FileStore.FrozenIDs reads snapshot ids and rejects unsafe segments
Verify: Exporter format, frozen-only, empty round and error tests

tests.name: TestExporter_OnlyFrozen
tests.title: Exporter includes only frozen contributions, in snapshot order, mapped onto the export shape
tests.scenario: Given a fake source with contributions A, B, C and frozen [C, A], When Export runs for world w and round ROUND-0000001, Then the export lists [C, A] only with Author, Content, CreatedAt, Version, WorldID and RoundID set

tests.name: TestExporter_EmptyRound
tests.title: An empty round exports a non-nil empty contributions list encoded as []
tests.scenario: Given a fake source with contributions but a nil frozen list, When Export runs, Then Contributions is non-nil with length 0 and the JSON contains "contributions":[]

tests.name: TestExporter_SourceErrors
tests.title: Source errors are propagated by Export and remain matchable with errors.Is
tests.scenario: Given an errSource whose FrozenIDs returns ErrNotFound, When Export runs, Then the error matches ErrNotFound. Given an errSource whose ListByRound returns a custom error, When Export runs, Then the error matches that custom error
tests.detail: PASS in 0.00s; subtests FrozenIDs_ErrNotFound_is_propagated and ListByRound_custom_error_is_propagated PASS

tests.name: TestExport_JSONShape
tests.title: Export marshals to the documented snake_case keys with RFC 3339 created_at
tests.scenario: Given an Export with one ExportContribution, When it is marshalled to JSON, Then the version, world_id, round_id, contributions, id, author, content and created_at keys are present with the expected values, and created_at is 2026-01-02T03:04:05Z

tests.name: TestFileStore_FrozenIDs/snapshot_lists_IDs_in_order
tests.title: FrozenIDs returns the snapshot's contribution IDs in listed order
tests.scenario: Given a round whose snapshot.yaml lists contributions 'a' and 'b', When FrozenIDs is called, Then it returns [a b] in snapshot order

tests.name: TestFileStore_FrozenIDs/missing_snapshot_returns_ErrNotFound
tests.title: FrozenIDs returns ErrNotFound when the round has no snapshot
tests.scenario: Given a round with no snapshot.yaml, When FrozenIDs is called, Then it returns ErrNotFound

tests.name: TestFileStore_FrozenIDs/parent_directory_world_ID
tests.title: FrozenIDs rejects a parent-directory world ID with a non-NotFound error
tests.scenario: Given a world ID '../x', When FrozenIDs is called, Then it returns a non-nil error that is not ErrNotFound

tests.name: TestFileStore_FrozenIDs/slash_in_round_ID
tests.title: FrozenIDs rejects a round ID containing a slash with a non-NotFound error
tests.scenario: Given a round ID 'a/b', When FrozenIDs is called, Then it returns a non-nil error that is not ErrNotFound
